about.note: S5 (P4): the six crates that circulate on the bench are Taylor's projects. Each key is a project id the simulation speaks in (sim/scenes/bench.ts PROJECT_CRATES maps crate ids to these). `resume` is the published title of its entry in resume.json projects.entries: the card's title, one line (the entry's subtitle) and tools (its tags) are read from that entry, carried, never retyped here. `anchor` is the id of its heading on /resume/ (src/pages/resume.astro: p- and the title slugged). `stencil.lines` is how the title is sprayed, line by line; joined with spaces they are the title in capitals (tests/unit/content/bench-projects.test.ts holds both). `for` is who it was built for, as /resume/ gives it.
